· Significantly below SMA100 (37,929 KRW) and SMA200 (36,315 KRW): mid-to-long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (37.5%): high relative to historical lows, low relative to highs.

· RSI trajectory (32.8 → 47.2): exiting oversold, consolidating in neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-750.0013 → 211.9761): shifting from bearish to improving, bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band 32,293 KRW): band width at 48.63% is wide, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance (34,850 KRW): close to SMA50 (34,631 KRW), short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.06x): average volume, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): entry decision requires confirmation of SMA20 breakout.
